title: Nous Research Raises $90M Series B at $1.5B Valuation to Bring Hermes AI Agents to Enterprises
source_used: TechCrunch (7 Oct 2026), which The AI Insider article rewrites
key_facts: Nous Research, developer of the open-source Hermes Agent, raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation, confirming earlier TechCrunch reporting.
Robot Ventures led; Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Samsung and 1789 Capital (where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner) took part.
Total funding is now $158 million; the company is three years old.
By the startup's estimates Hermes Agent has been cloned more than 24 million times and drives roughly 2.5% of global AI token usage.
The money funds "Hermes for Businesses", letting companies deploy customized AI agents for multi-step workflows while keeping data private.
The Wall Street Journal reported about $36 million in annualized revenue by mid-September 2026 and an expectation of more than $100 million by year end.
quote_evidence: Nous Research, the startup developing the open source Hermes Agent, has raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation, confirming TechCrunch’s earlier reporting.
Popular among developers and individuals, the open source Hermes Agent has been cloned more than 24 million times, driving roughly 2.5% of global AI token usage, according to the startup’s estimates.
Nous was at roughly $36 million in annualized revenue by mid-September 2026 and expects to pass $100 million before the end of 2026, The Wall Street Journal reported.
why_it_matters_hint: A free open-source AI agent is becoming a paid enterprise product.
notes: Older than the pool date: TechCrunch published 7 Oct 2026; The AI Insider (pool item, 8 Oct) rewrites it. WSJ reported the round first.
